resources.string: Disable external providers (%1$s) and enable built-in FolkZygisk for the next boot? Current injection will not change until reboot.

Disable built-in FolkZygisk for the next boot and activate %1$s? The current injection is unchanged until reboot. Other active external providers will block this operation.
Provider switch failed. Refresh the module list and FolkZygisk status before retrying.
%1$s was not activated: it conflicts with built-in FolkZygisk. Disable the built-in provider first; selection changes apply on reboot.
Module batch validation failed. No further modules were installed. Check the log.
